narrative.overview: Infusion Diffusion uses deep contrast, measured gold, tactile materials, and generous quiet to make home fragrance feel composed and intimate. Product meaning remains clear before language becomes poetic.
keyCharacteristics: Black glass, warm metal, wax, vapor, flame, and shadow.
Precise product language and restrained ornament.
Luxury for lived-in rooms rather than decorative display alone.

rules.name: The Measured Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is a material edge and action cue, not a universal outline or decorative wash.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Use the approved Figma foreground/background pairs. Body text must meet WCAG AA, and focus must remain visibly distinct.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Marcellus expresses; Manrope explains and operates. Do not introduce a third decorative type voice.

rules.name: The One Depth Signal Rule
rules.body: Use a border or a shadow on a surface, not both.

dos: Do let typography, product imagery, proportion, and material contrast carry the identity.
Do keep scent format, notes, size, care, safety, price, stock, and delivery information concrete.
Do preserve true product proportions and controlled gold highlights in photography.
Do show diffusers, sprays, and candles as one coherent family.
donts: Don't use towels, stacked stones, scattered florals, or other familiar spa shorthand as the default photographic world.
Don't introduce generic AI-design tells: purple gradients, glowing surfaces, gratuitous pills, nested card grids, or vague decorative copy.
Don't crop caps, flames, spray triggers, or reed tips when the image's job is product recognition.
Don't change Figma, DESIGN.md, runtime tokens, or Storybook in isolation.
